name: George App (Erste Bank Serbia)
summary: George is Erste Bank's mobile banking app, deployed in Serbia. It covers account management, card controls, spending categorization, loan applications, a travel information hub, and financial education content. The session reviewed the app as a returning user with existing bank products, exploring the full feature set from the home screen outward. This is a utility app, not a game — most of the 24-mechanic framework does not apply.
